title: Bhaalist Gloves

sources.title: Garrotte
markers: | summary = '''Garrotte''' is an action granted by {{SmRarityItem|Bhaalist Gloves}} that allows the user to wrap a rope around a target humanoid's throat, dealing damage and silencing it.

summary: Gain +1 to attack rolls and access to Garrotte.

fields.Garrotte: Action once per Short Rest. Target a Humanoid in melee. Deals 1d10 Bludgeoning. Concentration, up to 3 turns. DC 14 Strength resists Garrotted and its silence.
fields.Acquisition: Purchase from Echo of Abazigal at the Murder Tribunal after becoming an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal.
fields.Base value: 540 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and pinned evidence, then refined its mechanics against item and linked rule notes.
